title: Prefill Conservator + Quant Heuristic Exporter: tenant-safe defaults and offline audit tooling
author: Maya Singh
body: Background and motivation: tenants with bursty traffic were seeing unexpected unit-econ regressions after aggressive prefill and quant defaults were applied automatically. We need a conservative, tenant-scoped controller that can (a) apply safe prefill/caching defaults, (b) export the exact quantization heuristic and selector state for offline audit and replay, and (c) provide a safe fallback path that temporarily disables aggressive quant profiles when latency or quality SLOs are degraded. This PR implements the Prefill Conservator controller, a Quant Heuristic Exporter CLI, runtime guards for safe fallbacks, and wiring into the unit-econ telemetry pipeline. High level changes: 1) controller/prefill_conservator: tenant-scoped policy engine that evaluates warmup/prefill decisions using historical cold-start distributions and unit-econ thresholds; supports per-tenant overrides and an opt-in conservative default profile; exposes a metrics endpoint and admin gRPC hooks; includes unit and integration tests. 2) tooling/quant_exporter: CLI that snapshots the quant heuristic state (model selector scores, calibration histograms, fallback thresholds, and scoring weights) into a compact NDJSON export suitable for offline auditing and replay in the evaluation harness; includes schema versioning and checksum. 3) runtime/guards: lightweight runtime checks that detect transient latency/quality SLO violations and trigger an automatic conservative fallback to safe-precision profiles with a short decay window. 4) telemetry/unit_econ_adapter: new adapter that annotates traces with estimated per-request token cost delta when conservative fallbacks are applied; this powers alerts and tenant-level cost regressions. 5) docs and examples: CLI usage, policy examples, and a migration guide for operators. Backwards compatibility: defaults are conservative and disabled for tenants that previously set explicit prefill/quant presets; the exporter is read-only and cannot change live configuration. Testing: unit tests for policy decision logic, integration tests exercising the fallback path under simulated latency spikes, and an end-to-end smoke test that validates exported heuristics load back into the eval harness. Migration and rollout plan: graduated rollout behind a feature flag, canary to 5 tenants for 48h with expanded telemetry, then broad rollout if no regressions observed. Linear tickets and follow-ups listed below.

discussion: Luca Marino (reviewer): Can we have the exporter include the histogram bucket boundaries used for calibration? These are necessary to reproduce percentile calculations. Maya Singh (author): Added bucket boundaries to schema_v1 and included an example export; updated tests to assert roundtrip. Anya Patel (reviewer): The fallback window defaults to 30s which seems short for cold-chain recoveries in some tenants; suggest making it configurable per-tenant. Maya Singh: Exposed fallback_window_ms in tenant profile and added validation with sane bounds; updated docs. Derek Cho (reviewer): Please add one more load test that simulates a burst then sustained medium QPS to ensure we don't oscillate. Maya Singh: Added integration test prefill_fallback_test.go with oscillation guard and a jitter backoff. CI initially: integration/flaky_test timed out on first run; rerun succeeded. Reviewer approvals: Luca approved after bucket boundaries change, Anya approved after configurability changes, Derek requested one small naming nits which were squashed. Merge decision: squash and merge onto main after green CI.
ci_checks: CI summary: build: pass; unit tests: pass (all); integration: initial run had one timeout on flaky_test, rerun passed; lint: pass with two minor gofmt suggestions fixed in commit 1f2b3c4; e2e-smoke: pass; security-scan: pass. Total CI duration ~18m. No queue time anomalies. Artifact uploads: none. Flaky tests noted: integration/flaky_test historically flaps under heavy CI load; added retry decorator in test harness for this file.
merge: merged via squash on 2026-02-19 by Maya Singh. Merge commit message included a short summary and Linear refs ENG-9982 ENG-10014. Post-merge actions: enabled feature-flag rollout schedule, created alert ENG-10014-FLAG to track tenant regressions, and added migration task to infra board.
release_notes: Added Prefill Conservator controller: conservative tenant defaults for prefill/caching; Quant Heuristic Exporter CLI for offline auditing of quant selector state; runtime safe fallbacks to temporarily disable aggressive quant profiles under latency/quality regressions; unit-econ telemetry annotations to trace per-request cost deltas. Backwards compatible and behind feature flag.
